posts.name: Sanjana Reddy C
posts.cooked: Is it compulsory to submit the weekly assignments of system commands course through powershell commands or can we submit it via student study portal too?

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
BPT, NPPE, OPPE → On VM.

Grpas → On portal.

posts.name: Sanjana Reddy C
posts.cooked: I’m not sure if System commands course is BPT or grpa

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked: It has both and both are mandatory to submit.

posts.cooked:
25f2008330:

everything here is practice questions right?

Yeah, but at some dates BPTs will be released and they will be mandatory.

And oppe will be happening here as well.

And Grpas are on portal and mandatory.

posts.name: Sanjana Reddy C
posts.cooked: So I don’t have to submit any assignment here (powershell) for now. I have already submitted the GrPa’s in the study portal

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
Yes, no need to submit these for now (for grading purpose). But they are good for practice purpose.

BPTs will be releasing soon.

posts.name: vishnusrinivas g s
posts.cooked: what is the process of BPT? How it will be conducted? can anyone explain

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Solve → GAs on course portal, GrPAs on course portal and BPTs on VM.

You have to login to VM to solve BPTs. BPT 1 will be released on 20th Feb. For BPT 2-4 dates, check grading document.

How to solve them? Check the video below. (@zeusvishnu )

seek.onlinedegree.iitm.ac.in

Nptel Seekh

posts.name: vishnusrinivas g s
posts.cooked: For how many days a BPT is valid?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: The deadline is one week from the day of release. You will get a mail regarding the deadline.
